bootstrap_unit: Patient label in sourceS1, with all eligible author events together
patient_estimator: equal patient weight and equal event weight within patient
joint_resample: multinomial patient multiplicities shared by all estimators and contrasts
record_weight_meaning: published S2 breakpoint-record count, not read-support molecules
structural_scope: author labels, including unmatched; ecDNA is not an exclusive structural category
fusion_scope: published author yes/no fusion-transcript detection labels; no assay sensitivity claim
